question: Does the unchanged standalone five-release benchmark reproduce consistently across three sequential local matrices, and how do local absolute latency and paired ceiling effects compare descriptively with GitHub Actions run 36336273811?
authorization: User explicitly requested the standalone GitHub reproducer's whole matrix locally, repeated blocks to measure variation, after inspecting neighboring Herdr work. No reglab dependency, workload substitution, or GitHub rerun is included.
execution: Existing python3 repro.py and report.py only; sequential shell invocations, no new runtime or controller. Environment GITHUB_SHA records the actual frozen local commit; GITHUB_REPOSITORY and GITHUB_RUN_ID unset, so raw run_url remains honestly local. Replicate identity is the enclosing directory, not a fabricated Actions URL.
order_note: Varied order, not a fully counterbalanced five-position design. Within every version the original four fresh-JVM ABBA order remains unchanged.
on_failure: Stop the entire remaining sequence on the first nonzero runner/report result, changed source, or competing running Docker container. Preserve failed/partial artifacts and consumed output directories; no retry or ownership adoption. Existing runner owns its shared flock and exact-ID/owner-label cleanup; no outer acquisition of that same lock.
host_caveats: Same WSL2 host/boot, not three independent physical hosts. Linux preflight is quiet; Windows-side activity and frequency control are not observed. No CPU affinity, governor, cache dropping, service stopping or host-setting mutation.

analysis.unit: Two fresh paired JVM comparisons per release per repetition; requests are not independent replicates. Report all six pair ratios and three per-setting round summaries separately.
analysis.aggregation: For each round retain original median-of-two-block-medians cell summary, each paired ratio, and median across the two same-setting cells. Across rounds report median, minimum, maximum and relative range; do not pool requests or invent a confidence interval from three repetitions.
analysis.flag_note: Exploratory practical repeatability flags, not a new validity/reproduction gate or a statistical significance claim. Retain every valid outcome regardless of flags.
analysis.comparison: Compare with the preserved five-version hosted result as a separate environment; software/resource/fixture/query pins must match. One local host versus one hosted VM per version does not estimate population-wide host variance.
analysis.github_decision: Review observed variability before changing CI. No additional hosted workload authorized here; avoid default triple cost if existing paired-effect conclusions are stable. Absolute cross-version claims remain confounded on today's separate-VM matrix.

prior_manual_result.status: preliminary separate evidence; source_sha is local-uncommitted, excluded from the three planned repetitions

host.preflight: No running containers or shared-lock holder; low Linux load; Windows-side load not observed

outcome.residue: Native runner records every container clean; execution worker observed empty docker ps after completion.
